evidence.quote: The Morristown Select Board voted unanimously Aug. 31 to adopt an interim zoning bylaw imposing a moratorium on data centers and other defined 'high-impact uses' while the planning commission studies potential impacts and drafts zoning changes.

'One of the reasons for this moratorium being put in place is to get out in front of this and give ourselves two years to breathe,' said Don McDowell, chair of the selectboard.

decisions.notes: Verified against three independent sources including a detailed minutes-style account: unanimous Aug. 31, 2026 adoption of a 2-year interim zoning bylaw, 'high-impact use' definition (10+ MW, 57,600+ gal/day water, etc.) matches across all three.
